schema:name: Liu et al. (2025) Experimental Sulfide LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Liu et al. 2025 (GCA 393) Experimental sulfide Spot analysis ns-LA-Q-ICP-MS Guangzhou Inst. Geochemistry (column W of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v2.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: State Key Laboratory of Isotope Geochemistry, Guangzhou Institute of Geochemistry, CAS, China

ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished epoxy mount (same capsule section as glass protocol)
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: Same capsule section as silicate glass; sulfide grains ≥20 µm selected by SEM-BSE
ada:laserManufacturerModel: Resonetics 193 nm ArF excimer laser (coupled to Cetac Analyte HE system; same system as glass protocol)
ada:laserSpotGeometryDefault: 20 µm circular (sulfide; grain sizes >20 µm selected)
ada:ablationDurationPerSpotDefault: ~40 s (same protocol; grain size >20 µm selected)
ada:carrierGasAndFlowRateDefault: He (flow rate not stated; same system as glass protocol)
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol
ada:internalStandardApproach: Single element from EMP: Fe (FeOT from EMP for sulfide); NIST 610 as external standard
ada:internalStandardElement: Fe from EMP (FeOT wt% for sulfide)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Femtosecond laser reduces LIEF; NIST 610 external standard; Fe IS from EMP corrects for ablation yield; micronuggets identified from Au signal spikes and excluded from integration
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Same approach as glass; micronugget identification from Au signal spikes critical for sulfide analyses
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: NIST 610 (primary external standard); Fe from EMP as IS
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialsDefault: NIST SRM 612 and BCR-2G (same monitoring standard set as glass protocol)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Ablation Cell Type
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Cetac Analyte HE system (same as silicate glass protocol)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: N₂ or Ar mixed (same protocol as glass)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Drift Monitor Frequency
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Same bracketing as silicate glass protocol

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Single spot per location (sulfides; same acquisition parameters as glass but 20 µm spot)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Same approach as glass; Au spike identification critical for determining solubility vs. nugget contribution

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: No post-acquisition normalization beyond IS (Fe from EMP)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Additional Notes
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Analysis of quenched experimental pyrrhotite (Fe₁₋ₓS) from same piston-cylinder experiments; 20 µm spot required due to small grain size (5–50 µm); same instrument and analytical session as glass protocol

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.
